findings: Card backgrounds previously used undefined --surface and were transparent; --panel supplies coherent visible backgrounds.
Border and text colors preserve the locally inherited tokens. Enabled/disabled controls and wrapping remain readable in inspected desktop/mobile originals.
Existing light-theme body token overrides root accent presets, so light non-gold selections still inherit gold. This is a separate verified defect, not fixed or hidden by the local token checks.
fixesApplied: Replaced undefined surface token with declared panel token
